novel_features_built.name: Company compare
novel_features_built.description: See two to four companies' fundamentals side by side (valuation, margins, growth, insider activity) without tab-switching.
novel_features_built.rationale: No single Screener.in endpoint returns a cross-company comparison; the side-by-side view requires joining the local financials and trades mirror.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs to decide between candidate stocks on comparable fundamentals instead of fetching pages one at a time.

novel_features_built.name: Quarterly trend
novel_features_built.description: Spot whether a company's quarterly profit/sales growth is accelerating or deteriorating, with YOY change and margin drift computed automatically.
novel_features_built.rationale: Screener.in renders a wide raw HTML table; the YOY-change and consecutive-decline flags require local computation over the synced quarterly table.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs the trend shape of a company's earnings, not just the latest quarter's raw numbers.

novel_features_built.name: Screen overlap
novel_features_built.description: Find companies that appear in two or more stock screens in one command, replacing spreadsheet dedup.
novel_features_built.rationale: Screens are separate paginated HTML tables; intersecting them by symbol is a cross-screen join no single page provides.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs the intersection of multiple screening strategies to find high-conviction candidates.

novel_features_built.name: Screen rank
novel_features_built.description: Re-score a screen's companies with a composite of fundamentals (P/E, ROCE, growth), sorted by what matters to you.
novel_features_built.rationale: Joining screen membership with cached fundamentals produces a composite rank no endpoint provides.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent should prioritize within a screen by fundamentals or insider conviction rather than the default table order.

novel_features_built.name: Insider flow
novel_features_built.description: Answer 'who is net buying the most this month?' with per-company insider buy/sell aggregation.
novel_features_built.rationale: The insider-trades endpoint returns chronological rows; net per-company flows require local aggregation over the synced trades table.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs insider conviction ranked by net value, not a raw list of individual trades.
